test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 23 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹3000 as a sum borrowed at 8% per year rate of interest for 2 years.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹3000

Rate of Interest (R) = 8% per year

Time (T) = 2 years

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = dfrac{P times R times T}{100}

**Calculations:**

SI = dfrac{3000 times 8 times 2}{100}

⇒ SI = dfrac{48000}{100}

⇒ SI = ₹480

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**
